title: Star Wars Banners
description: This Datapack adds Star Wars symbols to banners. These will show up in the loom.
body:
# Info
This Datapack adds custom Star Wars symbols to Minecraft. 
The symbols are directly selectable in the loom.
Currently the following symbols are added:
- Imperial Crest
- Republic Crest
- CIS Roundel
- Jedi Order
- Phoenix Squadron Crest
- Rebel Alliance Crest
- Mudhorn Sigil
- Mythosaur Skull
- Naboo Crest

# Installation
In the versions tab there is the datapack and the resourcepack. You will need to download both and place the resourcepack into your resourcepack folder. The datapack should be in the datapack folder for your world.

# Solutions to problems
**The new banner patterns show up but have a weird/missing texture. Also the translation is not working.**

You will need to download/activate the resourcepack.
